work_packet_header.workstream: authenticated classical and quantum control branch
work_packet_header.capability_or_component: vacuum-to-selected-member 1024-cell validated continuation tube, overlap, no-fold and terminal containment ABI
work_packet_header.current_maturity: endpoint, chart maps, inverse/radii predicates defined; no continuation cell executed
work_packet_header.target_maturity: independently audited deterministic continuation definition suitable for disjoint fixture producers
required_frozen_inputs: 1024 cells on lambda in [0,1] and shat_0(lambda)=1+lambda/5
stop_fail_criteria: using a coarse-grid state to initialize a finer terminal solve
using right-end observations to alter a cell predictor or inverse
an overlap or containment interval touching its boundary
skipping, retrying, subdividing or reordering a cell
candidate evaluation, root creation, authorization or authority promotion
explicit_non_goals: G3, quantum products or physical claims
work_packet_header.downstream_gate_unlocked: classical continuation-definition component after independent audit; implementation remains blocked on remaining R1 definitions

cell_inventory.vacuum_cell: i=0 uses eta=lambda/(5*delta), xi=sqrt(eta)*r and the scaled vacuum state/grid chart
cell_inventory.positive_cells: i=1..1023 use the positive-kappa physical-r state/grid chart

prerequisite_terminal_solves.rule: each lambda=1 terminal grid solve is initialized independently from the same authenticated analytic seed and completes before continuation proof construction
prerequisite_terminal_solves.purpose: the terminal N=256 ball is an independently obtained containment target, not a predictor for the continuation cells

cell_center_tube.dyadic_projection: x_i_left,v_i_left,a_i_left are exact dyadic vectors produced by the producer's frozen deterministic projection algorithm before that cell's inverse or Y/Z values
cell_center_tube.projection_acceptance: directed residual and tangent-defect balls for all three dyadic vectors are mandatory inputs to Y and Z1
cell_center_tube.right_observation_forbidden: no value first observed at lambda=(i+1)/1024 may alter the already frozen cell-i center, derivatives, inverse, work budget or radii

sequential_left_endpoint_rule.cell_0: x_0_left is the exact dyadic center of the proved SP endpoint ball mapped into the eta=0 vacuum layout
sequential_left_endpoint_rule.cell_i_positive: for i>=1, x_i_left is the producer's deterministic exact-dyadic projection of the preceding accepted right-end center/ball evidence after the required chart map when i=1
sequential_left_endpoint_rule.projection_containment: the projected point must lie strictly inside the preceding accepted right-end ball with a directed positive margin
sequential_left_endpoint_rule.chronology: cell i+1 projection and construction begin only after cell i proof, right-end persistence and self-hash complete
sequential_left_endpoint_rule.failure: projection outside/touching, missing preceding proof or chronology mismatch is terminal at cell i+1

cell_validation.inverse_and_bounds: each cell uses one immutable producer-specific inverse record and Y,Z0,Z1,Z2 under validated-inverse-radii.v1
cell_validation.parameter_supremum: all bounds cover the entire closed Lambda_i and selected state ball, not sampled parameter points
cell_validation.unique_tube: a pass proves one unique solution x_i(lambda) inside the varying center ball for every lambda in Lambda_i
cell_validation.simple_kernel: the contraction/inverse margin proves D_xF is invertible throughout the cell ball
cell_validation.no_fold: lambda is the exact independent parameter and D_xF remains invertible, so the normalized branch is one graph over Lambda_i with no fold

same_chart_overlap.boundaries: between cells i and i+1 for i=1..1022
same_chart_overlap.meaning: one complete validated ball lies strictly inside the other; the contained ball's zero belongs to both uniqueness regions, so both claims identify the same boundary solution
same_chart_overlap.touching: if neither directed strict containment passes, including equality/touching, overlap fails

chart_handoff.boundary: lambda=1/1024 between vacuum cell 0 and positive cell 1
chart_handoff.map: the exact state/grid v2 tail map Q=q/epsilon on Q in [0,1/255], q in [0,epsilon/255], together with the exact core reconstruction into common physical observables
chart_handoff.comparison_space: common physical [m,b,s,sigma,p,omega] value/first-derivative balls on the complete overlap cover plus ADM mass
chart_handoff.strict_containment: in every frozen comparison norm, either the positive cell-1 left physical ball is strictly contained in the mapped vacuum cell-0 right ball or the mapped vacuum ball is strictly contained in the positive ball; one common direction must hold for the joint product ball
chart_handoff.interface_warning: physical r=255 and scaled xi=255 patch interfaces are not equated
chart_handoff.failure: any missing cover, denominator margin, non-overlap or touching is terminal

terminal_containment.boundary: lambda=1 at the right endpoint of cell 1023
terminal_containment.continuation_ball: the cell-1023 accepted right-end positive-chart ball
terminal_containment.terminal_ball: the independently solved and continuum-validated N=256 selected-member ball
terminal_containment.same_solution: strict containment plus uniqueness identifies the continuation endpoint with the frozen selected-member terminal solution
terminal_containment.no_grid_promotion: grid agreement alone never substitutes for this continuum containment

first_failure_and_records.cell_order: 0 through 1023 with no skip or retry
first_failure_and_records.terminal_precedence: terminal N=256 containment runs only after cell 1023 passes
first_failure_and_records.record_chain: each cell record binds the exact previous cell self-hash; cell 0 binds the endpoint record
first_failure_and_records.first_failure: the first failing cell and within-cell role terminates the lane and becomes immutable evidence

allowed: scalar and finite-vector operators with exact known branches
